scope: Bounded Indian development-only vision cohort preparation

sourceChecks.labelProvenance: Paper reports manual annotation and separate QA; regional imagery/label terms apply
sourceChecks.terms: Region-specific attribution/permissions; no India-specific terms established
sourceChecks.reason: Publisher attribution has no country entry identified as India. Gorakhpur is listed as Nepal; name alone cannot resolve that geography. No archive acquired.

sourceChecks.version: Publisher WHU-Mix (Vector) page/table checked; release version unspecified
sourceChecks.labelProvenance: Publisher describes vector annotation/correction; source table retained and visually inspected
sourceChecks.terms: Upstream source terms vary; Indian slice and its terms not established
sourceChecks.reason: Published table does not identify an Indian region; CrowdAI unknown region and WHU East Asia cannot establish India. No dataset archive acquired.

sourceChecks.geographyClaim: Paper/README name New Delhi and Mumbai among six cities; this is dataset-level provenance, not selected-file geography
sourceChecks.labelProvenance: Paper section IV.A reports OSM vectors, real-estate maps and manual verification using local field reports, plus imagery cross-validation. This was read through the public full-text web tool, not inferred from affiliation.
sourceChecks.terms: README claims MIT but LICENSE absent from pinned repository tree and linked LICENSE returned 404. Paper CC BY 4.0 does not license dataset imagery or third-party vectors. Dataset/imagery reuse and redistribution terms remain unspecified; record as launch-clearance gap.
sourceChecks.listingScope: One public HTML listing page (50 entries each) for publisher train images, masks and georeferenced images; not an exhaustive inventory. Publisher test folder not opened.
sourceChecks.pairFormatFinding: Public train layout uses numeric PNG/TIFF and mask_<id>.geojson, unlike repository city/images + city/masks PNG loader; source mask values, buffer fields and roof/base footprint semantics need a pinned transfer policy.
sourceChecks.reason: Only two small train GeoJSON probes acquired. Both near Lahore, not India. No file-to-Indian-city index found in checked metadata; no eligible image downloaded, no complete pair or alignment claim.

evaluatorContract.building: Existing RF-DETR development evaluator requires image and truth/scoring masks in the exact image pixel frame; raw affine, CRS, source polygons, holes/partials and ignore policy must be pinned before admission
evaluatorContract.floor_plan: Existing CubiCasa evaluator uses 12 room/wall classes; native room SVG/vector annotations need exact source pixel frame and justified class mapping. A building polygon or document caption is not a floor-region target

minimumRecoveryInputs: Publisher index mapping at least two small New Delhi or Mumbai development image/annotation pairs to exact filenames and coordinates, with originals and crop/affine/CRS

Publisher annotation policy/review lineage for those pairs, resolving OSM/real-estate-derived boundaries, buffer fields, roof/base definition, missing/ambiguous buildings and ignore regions; otherwise independent human boundary review
For floor route separately: Indian original plans and independent reviewed room/wall vectors with source pixel axes and class mapping
launchClearanceGaps: Dataset imagery/vector terms and third-party attribution; repository MIT claim has no LICENSE file; paper licence alone is insufficient
preservation: Existing 19 foreign D06 development pairs/groups and all training/final/closed holdouts untouched; no pair promoted or resplit
